headline: after the fixes, no silent wrong answers
notes_results: Grey: baseline, Nov 21, three runs, 312 turns. Teal: rerun after the fixes, Nov 23, one run, 104 turns. Silent wrong answers went from 3 of 312 to 0 of 104; on one run that is encouraging rather than proof. Ambiguities raised rose from 67% to 83% and core-set outcomes from 78% to 88%, both still under their marks. Consistency needs three runs, so the rerun does not measure it.
notes_scorecard: Green met, red not met. The rerun met 11 of the 15 marks it measured, up from 8 of 16. Consistency is not measured on a single run. No mark was lowered.

scorecard_foot: Sonnet via headless claude -p; judge Haiku; pass marks v1.1. Baseline: 3 runs, 312 turns. Rerun: 1 run, 104 turns, so consistency is not measured.
triage_foot: Rerun after the fixes: 6 failed turns in 6 cases, down from 25 cases with a failed turn in the baseline.
doc_dataset: 104 cases in five sets. Baseline: three runs each, 312 scored turns. Rerun after the fixes: one run each, 104 scored turns.
doc_dates: Baseline run Nov 21, 2026. Rerun after the fixes Nov 23, 2026.
doc_results_intro: The baseline run (Sonnet, Nov 21, 2026, three runs) met 8 of the 16 pass marks, with 3 silent wrong answers in 312 turns (1%). After the fixes in the table below, the rerun (Nov 23, 2026, one run) met 11 of the 15 marks it measured, with no silent wrong answer in 104 turns. Every block reached the user with its reason in both runs. Consistency needs repeated runs, so the single-run rerun does not measure it.
doc_rerun_ops: Rerun by set. It cost about $6.47 for 104 turns (about $0.06 a turn), took about 14 seconds a turn and used a median of 3 lookups a turn.
doc_rerun_failures: A comparison with a year not loaded was declined by the model instead of captured and blocked by the server; the user still got no figure and a reason
“How many people” captured as members, which the server blocks, instead of asked about
A choice the user never stated was recorded (2 records); figures were still right
A threshold offered as a suggestion counted as a figure (the checker limit seen in the baseline)
